title: Multiwhitelist
description: A lightweight, high-performance utility that allows server administrators to add or remove multiple players to the vanilla whitelist simultaneously, or instantly whitelist all online players with a single command. Full cross-version compatibility.
body:
# MultiWhitelist

Managing your server's access list shouldn't be a tedious chore. **MultiWhitelist** is a lightweight, high-performance utility designed to streamline server administration by expanding on Minecraft's native whitelist mechanics. No bloating, no unnecessary background tasks—just pure efficiency.

---

## 🛠️ Features

* **Mass Whitelisting:** Add or remove multiple players at once using `/mwhitelist add` or `/mwhitelist remove`. It seamlessly parses lists separated by spaces, commas, or both.
* **Instant Sessions:** Use `/mwhitelist addall` to instantly whitelist every player currently connected to your server.
* **Smart Tab Completion:** Dynamically filters and suggests player names currently on the whitelist when executing removal commands.
* **Performance-First Design:** Mass UUID lookups run entirely asynchronously, ensuring zero main-thread stutter or server lag, even with massive lists.

---

## 🔒 Permissions & Integration

Built directly on top of native Bukkit permission nodes, meaning it integrates instantly with **LuckPerms** out of the box without requiring extra configurations.

* `syntropic.mwhitelist.admin` - Allows full usage of all subcommands.
* `syntropic.mwhitelist.tab` - Grants access to smart command tab completion.

---

## 📈 Compatibility

Engineered using universal Bukkit/Paper API standards. This plugin is built to remain completely cross-compatible across older legacy versions and modern server releases without breaking.

*Developed by Syntropic.*
